title: Harmonia Mundi in 53-EDO — Four Movements Across the Syntonic Comma
description: A ~5-minute stage-independent classical 53-EDO symphonic poem fusing Mozartian lyrical counterpoint, Debussy 7-limit (4:5:6:7:9) impressionism, prominent Indian classical 53-EDO shruti dialogue (Dotara, Ektara, Sitar), Beethovenian rhythmic drama across a chromatic-mediant diesis summit and triple downward comma cascade, and a unified Cathedral Pipe Organ finale. Pair with --stage stages/concert_hall.json (or intimate_circle.json / east_west_split.json).
